title: Fine-tuning brain stimulation to fight Parkinson’s disease
excerpt: Neuroscientists are developing a new type of brain implant that will decode every movement and symptom of people with this neurodegenerative condition, seeking better ways to ease symptoms.
content_html:
• OUTLOOK
  • 04 November 2026

Neuroscientists are developing a new type of brain implant that will decode every movement and symptom of people with this neurodegenerative condition, seeking better ways to ease symptoms.

By

  • Liam Drew0
  1. Liam Drew

    1. Liam Drew is a freelance science journalist based near London.

Sixteen years ago, Simon Little was a junior neurologist thinking of devoting his time to international health work. But then he attended a lecture by Peter Brown.
